source_evidence: Day328~11:25 exact player 'Yes' accepts Harthvale's offer to arrange preliminary accounts review, not the 250gp capital contribution, facility access, partnership, transaction, or unrelated V action. Harthvale instructs broker to fetch the existing accounts custodian from nearby storehouse1, asking him to bring the relevant business records for a prospective partner; broker departs and returns with custodian and records after ordinary walking/preparation time. This is new actual NPC movement consistent with known office200ft downhill, fixed keeper role (dm-ferry-setup.md @72d5bde0ab9d84d89fdc63f20cf9c7bfb63b1516), and Harthvale's voluntarily offered review. Keeper is the same accountant whose payment papers V read D326, not another NPC or duplicate custodian. No proper name assigned, no assumption that he recognizes V or knows about missing acknowledgement, covert office search, or Watch investigation. First-play visual detail: tired, ink-stained fingers, carefully guarded ledger. He opens a limited review in the existing upper office, retains custody of records and voluntarily shows matching joint freight account entries D320 advance inspection notice6gp paid and D323 advance inspection notice8gp paid via broker reimbursement, and Lot27 case lace transferred from storehouse1 to storehouse2 sold36gp credit joint freight account. These are previously established entries, newly displayed openly to party by authorized custodian in this meeting, not new payments or sale, and corroborate Harthvale's earlier admission. No independent authentication by authorities, duplicate proceeds, financial statement, unverified cash balance, original surrender, copy permission or blanket access to private client records. Keeper says 'These are examples of the business we have been doing. I can explain the accounts, but the individual customers' books are not mine to hand over.' Harthvale says 'If you're considering becoming a partner, what would you need to see?' Mara ready to assist, Cirren recognizes relevance to evidence and Fenar attentive. Keeper's own guarded demeanor is visible, not an automatic clue to guilt/defection or proof of an immediate threat. No other households consulted or assented yet, no deal, payment, specific violence, new contraband, arrest, or new check. V chooses what to inspect/ask; documents still custodian-held and today's admissions not yet reported to Desen. No resource changes.
